tiktok.author: shyyy.cat
tiktok.body:
why is the app glitching so bad? is it happening to anyone else?? 🥲 #tiktokglitch #tiktokproblems #captions
I'm getting really frustrated with TikTok because I wanna be able to put captions on my videos because I want them to be accessible and everything, but for whatever reason the app is glitching. So anytime I'm replying to someone's comment and like, their little comment shows up up here or whatever, anytime I try to add the captions to that video, it removes their comment and it just glitches and disappears. So then it looks like I'm not replying to anybody. And I don't know why it's doing that. I've updated the app, I've done everything I can. I have no idea why it's doing that. So if anyone has noticed that some of my videos don't have captions, the reason why is because the app is glitching so bad that I have no idea how to add the captions to those videos without screwing those videos up. Um, I. I really don't know what's causing this glitch, so if anyone knows, I would love to be clued in. But um. I guess I'm just gonna have to wait until TikTok fixes it because I. I don't know. Like I said, I updated the app and everything, so I would assume that would have fixed it. It did not. So yeah, I don't know. I don't know what to do.
